title: RoomEdit
description: Research experiment on multi-turn language editing of 3D rooms: a 2x2 design comparing direct pose patches against typed actions with a solver, with and without checker feedback. Scored against hidden constraint sets by an independent evaluator, with a Next.js viewer.

title: BiasLens
description: Explainable multimodal bias analysis pipeline for short-form video, built for the Gemma 4 Developer Competition. Local detectors feed two Gemma agents with human-in-the-loop review, producing bias reports and annotated video.

title: Jarvis
description: Personal command center inspired by Iron Man's J.A.R.V.I.S.: an animated HUD dashboard over my connected tools (Notion, Slack, Linear, Calendar), driven by clicking into areas or by a voice assistant. Both routes go through the same LangGraph agent behind a FastAPI backend.

title: HanziSave
description: Turns the Chinese I am reading into flashcards: paste text or photograph a page, see words coloured by HSK level, and generate cards in a fixed format. Includes FSRS spaced repetition, stroke-order writing practice, and Anki export.

title: FixRay
description: AR repair assistant: point the phone camera at something broken and get a highlighted region, a direction arrow and one instruction on the live feed, gated by a green/amber/red safety rating.

title: Ethical Interface Workbench
description: Interactive AI face simulator and design-ethics lab. Eight live sliders drive an animated face, while an analysis panel rates each design choice as Ethical, Caution or Risk across healthcare, education and security scenarios.

title: ScrumiX
description: AI-powered Scrum management system that enhances agile team productivity through intelligent automation and AI-agent assistance. Next.js frontend talking to a FastAPI backend that orchestrates the business logic and AI workflows.

title: Resume Agent
description: Autonomous human-in-the-loop AI agent that rewrites and optimizes resumes against a target job description. Covers automated JD scraping, PDF resume parsing, gap analysis, iterative rewriting, and user-guided refinement.

title: MOAT Stock Explainer
description: Multimodal LLM-based system that explains historical stock behavior of MOAT-rated tech companies to non-experts. Fuses financial news with price time-series data to generate plain-language causal narratives.

title: Financial Sentiment Analyzer
description: AI-powered financial sentiment analysis platform built for the Aachen Investment Club. FinBERT processes text and PDF reports, a FastAPI backend serves sentiment inference, and a chatbot delivers interactive financial insights.

title: DragFlow
description: Interactive web-based drag-and-drop workflow builder in React and Next.js. A FastAPI backend manages roles and persists workflow state, enabling dynamic assignment and reordering inside a visual planning area.

title: YAMS
description: Management platform developed in a team at Fraunhofer IPT with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL. Stores inquiries, acquisitions, and related records behind an intuitive interface for creating and sharing entries.

title: TOTP Generator
description: Time-based one-time password generator following RFC 6238, like the codes in two-factor authentication apps. Built with standard libraries only, as a console tool for educational purposes.

title: Pomodoro Scheduler
description: Personalized Pomodoro day-scheduler in Java: 50-minute focus blocks, short and long breaks, and predefined slots for meals and exercise, all generated automatically in a clear console interface.
